summary: Batch 2 (Step 2 live Board Member Profile & Recommitment) verified end-to-end. Backend: 35/35 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_batch2_reactivation.py covering (a) auth guards — roster requires auth (401) + reactivation entitlement (recruitment-only member returns 403), admin overview rejects non-admin; (b) roster + add — empty state, add creates NOT SENT card with token, dedupe returns status 'exists' without duplicate, missing name/email → 422, import from opportunity_applications with owner_user_id + status Selected creates member and removes from existing_people, re-import returns exists; (c) tenant isolation — user B roster does not include user A's members, direct GET/POST on user A's member_record_id from user B returns 404; (d) email preview + send — initial subject 'Board Recommitment & Profile | TESTBatch2 Nonprofit', reminder subject correct, body contains 'This is not about pressuring anyone to stay.' and all bullet list items, no '[Organization Name]' placeholder, form_link contains /board-recommitment/{token}. Actual send to delivered@resend.dev succeeds → status NOT SENT→SENT + last_sent_at set; resend keeps same form_token; reminder writes last_reminder_at; call-script includes member first name + org, no 'dead weight' language; call-notes PUT persists; (e) public form — GET /api/board-recommitment/{token} returns org, prefill, allow_advisory=true + allow_support_role=false, exact 5 recommitment_options; invalid token → 404; POST with missing confirmation → 422, invalid recommitment string → 422, valid → 201, status COMPLETED + response + submitted_at persisted; GET revisit shows submitted=true, re-POST → 409; (f) founder side — GET /response 200 for completed member with recommitment answer preserved, 404 for not-yet-completed (bob), roster progress reflects completed=1; (g) admin overview — 200 with admin cookie, returns rows containing customer/organization/board_members/forms_sent/forms_completed, no raw response body; (h) regression — /api/funnel-leads/reactivation still 201, /api/payments/reactivation-diy-checkout still 200, /api/board-reactivation-intake/context bogus session_id 404, recruitment workspace endpoint still gated. Frontend: logged in as seeded reactivation member, /app/reactivation/self-guided/module/2 shows title 'Reactivating Your Board', 'Coming Soon' video placeholder, intro 'Find Out Who Is Ready to Stand Up', 'Board Recommitment Progress' counts, ADD CURRENT BOARD MEMBER modal fully functional, card appears with NOT SENT badge, SEND RECOMMITMENT FORM opens review modal with correct subject/body/link, SEND transitions status to SENT, all post-SENT actions (COPY LINK, SEND REMINDER, VIEW CALL SCRIPT, RESEND FORM) render, call script modal shows respectful script with org name and no 'dead weight' language, Save Call Notes persists (button changes to 'Notes Saved'). Public form loads without auth: h1 'Board Member Profile & Recommitment Form', supporting text mentions org, no 'dead weight' / 'step up or step down' language anywhere, Advisory follow-up question rendered but support role question NOT rendered (matches intake), 5 recommitment options + 26 expertise checkboxes + SUBMIT MY RESPONSE button visible; invalid token URL renders 'This Link Is Not Valid'. CONTINUE TO STEP 3 button routes to module/3.
action_items: Consider making origin_of() in reactivation_routes.py fall back to X-Forwarded-Host / referer instead of the hardcoded https://nonprofitboardbuilder.com default. In the preview environment, same-origin fetch from the SPA does not send an Origin header, so recommitment form links generated in the preview point to the production host. Not a blocker (spec only forbids localhost/TEST/[Organization Name] and prod URL is acceptable), but callers on preview will get an unresolvable link if the token is not also in prod DB.
critical_code_review_comments: reactivation_routes.py:270 — send_form raises 502 on any resend.Emails.send_async exception; consider also updating db status/last_sent_at only after success (already correct). Good.

reactivation_routes.py:344 — response dict stores payload.email lowercased and also overwrites root name/email on the parent doc; make sure UI VIEW RESPONSE still displays original submitted name. Verified working.

reactivation_routes.py:355 — founder notification VIEW link uses origin_of(request) which in preview falls back to production host (see action_items). Send failure is caught + logged, does not break 201 submission — correct.
reactivation_routes.py:174 — public_record intentionally omits form_token, response, and submitted-at prev; that keeps founder-facing UI safe. Good.

reactivation_routes.py — no explicit unique index on (user_id,email) for reactivation_board_members; dedupe is enforced only in application code. Under concurrent adds a duplicate could slip through. Low risk given single-founder workflow but worth adding a partial unique index.
admin overview iterates purchases collection and issues N+1 founder_context lookups — fine at current scale, may need aggregation if customer count grows.
